stages.body: Play the story from the opening mission Gone Fishing through the end of Chapter 1. Before the chapter ends, do the one thing that can pass you by: after the mission Down to Earth, talk to Lucia in the kitchen at Jason's house in the morning, follow her to the balcony and accept her meditation offer (see Positive Mental Attitude). There is no mission replay, so keep a manual save at the start and end of each chapter — the game has 15 manual save slots.
items: Just Like Paradise — complete Gone Fishing
Paradise Lost — complete Chapter 1
Positive Mental Attitude — do the Chapter 1 balcony meditation (potentially missable)
stages.title: Stage 1 — Story, Chapter 1

stages.body: Finish Chapter 2 and keep playing the story. After the mission Coffee Break you can switch between Jason and Lucia and roam together — that unlocks the partner trophies and the character-specific questlines (Andy's is Lucia-only; Tyrone's and Bret's are Jason-only). Kenton and Billy's questlines also open in this stretch, and the Scooter Bros app and garages arrive after the missions Moses and Daily Driver.
items: T**s Ass Drug Money — complete Chapter 2
Trust — complete Breakfast Run
Road to Rehabilitation, The Lone Rider, Fair Game — questlines open
Little Boxes, On the Spot — garages and Scooter Bros unlock
stages.title: Stage 2 — Story, Chapter 2

stages.body: Finish Chapter 3. This chapter unlocks the robbery systems the later trophies need: jewelry store robberies and the Snap Gun (Sneakthief), the Key Cloner (Capital Offense, Supply & Demand) and the Dye Pack Jammer for laundering marked bills (Dime on the Dollar). Do the optional missions as they appear — they introduce those systems.
items: Vice City, Baby! — complete Chapter 3
Break the Bank — complete The Cartel Heist
Sneakthief, Capital Offense, Dime on the Dollar — tools unlock
stages.title: Stage 3 — Story, Chapter 3

stages.body: Finish Chapter 4 and the final chapter. The optional mission That's Where The Money Is… opens the large bank-vault robberies (Maximum Withdrawal, A Classic Blitz Play) and the 4-star wanted escapes (Hot Together). After the final mission the game returns you to free-roam and the 100% completion checklist unlocks under Progress > Stats.
items: Top Of The World, Ma — complete Chapter 4
Family Matters, DWNFALL, Hi-Jacked — Chapter 4 missions
Snow Storm — Chapter 5 mission
You Gotta Know When to Get Off — complete the final mission
stages.title: Stage 4 — Story, Chapters 4–5 and the finale

stages.body: Finish the eight stranger strands that count (Kirk, Kyle, Yago and Pilot Pete are confirmed) and the character questlines that are still open: Andy (Lucia), Kenton, Billy, Randy and Tyrone (Jason), Bret (Jason). All of them stay available in free-roam after the story, and every trophy-related quest giver comes back, so nothing here can be missed.

This Was No Boat Accident — Kenton's final mission

stages.title: Stage 5 — Side strands and character questlines

stages.body: Work the big counts in free-roam: 250 stunts (300 for 100%), gold in all 42 Shooting Range challenges, a drone-race win at all 14 Top Fun locations, 20 different race wins, 100 WAiNK scans, 100 vehicles discovered, all 52 Leonida areas explored, 3 card sets (15 for 100%), 18 meditation spots, 8 garages, 10 Scooter Bros registrations, 50 challenges (70 for 100%), 5 bank vaults, one illegal operation per gang (all 39 for 100%), $250,000 laundered and $100,000 spent. Scan vehicles and locations with WAiNK as you travel — it feeds several trophies at once.

stages.title: Stage 6 — Collectibles, races and robberies

stages.body: Finish the 100% completion checklist (Progress > Stats > 100% Completion) for A Long Road, the gold trophy and the longest grind. It is far more forgiving than it sounds — closer to 60% true completion: most side quests are not required, and of the collectibles you typically need only part of each set (200 of 277 vehicles, 100 of 255 animals). Only the robberies, underwater discoveries, shooting ranges, drone races and Bret's quests need doing in full, plus any 70 of the 80 challenges. Nothing on it is missable. Then sweep up the remaining one-off trophies: the UFO easter egg, the bike kicks, the showroom smash, the cocktail, the bowling valuables, the partner escapes and the 500 criminal-profile actions. The platinum pops when the last trophy does.

stages.title: Stage 7 — 100% completion, clean-up and platinum

warnings: Cheats disable trophies and saving — do not use them on your platinum run.
There is no mission replay: keep a manual save at the start and end of each chapter (15 manual slots).

Only one trophy is potentially missable: Positive Mental Attitude — do the Chapter 1 balcony meditation with Lucia before Chapter 1 ends. It is not yet confirmed whether that meditation is required, so do it to be safe.
The Irredeemable criminal profile is permanent and makes police far more aggressive — avoid it.

Some optional missions expire (hourglass icon) and some quest givers are temporarily unavailable, but PowerPyx confirms none of that affects any trophy: every trophy-related character returns after the story.
